raw_pauc: Empirical piecewise-linear ROC integral over FPR 0 to 0.10
public_files: Aggregate estimates and analysis code; individual predictions are excluded
validation_scope: NumPy point estimates and CPU tests; no repeated GPU inference or training
limitations: Cutoffs are estimated on the evaluated external labels
Empirical specificity is not a population guarantee
Released units do not establish development/external patient independence
Fixed-seed resampling omits retraining and model-selection uncertainty
